evals.name: save-session-basic
evals.prompt: Tôi làm vi?c c? bu?i sáng r?i, s?a xong cái bug trong PlayerController.cs, dang làm d? cái inventory system. Mai tôi làm ti?p. Luu session giúp tôi.
evals.expected_output: A .md file saved to .opencode/sessions/ capturing the session context including the bug fix in PlayerController.cs and the in-progress inventory system work, with clear next steps.

assertions.name: session_file_created
assertions.description: A .md session file was created in .opencode/sessions/ directory

assertions.name: has_required_sections
assertions.description: File contains at least: What we were working on, Done, In progress, Next steps, Decisions locked

assertions.name: has_next_steps
assertions.description: File includes concrete Next steps section

evals.name: restore-session-and-continue
evals.prompt: Ð?c file .opencode/sessions/2026-07-30-1103-fix-player-bug.md và tôi mu?n làm ti?p.
evals.expected_output: Agent reads the file, summarizes the session (fix-player-bug), states what was in progress and next steps, then waits for user command.

assertions.name: acknowledged_session
assertions.description: Response acknowledges the session title or topic (Fix PlayerController null reference bug)

assertions.name: summarized_in_progress
assertions.description: Mentions what was in progress (inventory system / InventoryComponent)

assertions.name: stated_next_step
assertions.description: Mentions a concrete next step (implement RemoveItem / create UI)

assertions.name: did_not_auto_execute
assertions.description: Agent did NOT start implementing code automatically — waited for user command

evals.name: save-with-explicit-path
evals.prompt: /save-session C?n luu cái này g?p tru?c khi t?t máy
evals.expected_output: Session saved with default path naming, covering all context sections.

evals.name: restore-list-sessions
evals.expected_output: Agent lists available session files from .opencode/sessions/ and asks user to pick one.

assertions.name: listed_or_loaded
assertions.description: Agent either listed available sessions or loaded the existing session

assertions.name: no_auto_execute
assertions.description: Agent did not start implementing code

assertions.name: waited_for_user
assertions.description: Agent asked user what to do next or waited for command
